caveats: Meta and Google use different attribution windows — conversion counts are not directly comparable.
Spend figures are reported by each platform and may differ from actual billed amounts.
Geographic matching is based on campaign name pattern — not all campaigns will have a geoId.
Platform-reported conversions are not verified customer conversions (signup/KYC/transfer).
meta.method: Authenticated read-only pull from XPAT Meta and Google Ads accounts, normalized to a unified schema and deduplicated by platform+campaign+adset+date.
meta.source: Meta Marketing API v20.0 + Google Ads API v17
